items.title: Critical Java flaw puts cyber insurance patching duties in focus
items.summary: A severe vulnerability in Oracle’s Java platform has prompted regulatory alerts and brought cyber insurance patching conditions into sharp focus for brokers and underwriters.

items.title: Zurich raises Beazley integration synergy targets following completion of acquisition
items.summary: Zurich has increased its financial synergy estimates for its acquisition of specialist re/insurer Beazley following detailed post-completion analysis.
